[{"insert":"Push Up + Internal Dumbbell Lateral Raise

Two pressing movements that hit the chest and shoulders from different angles, back to back. The push up accumulates horizontal pressing volume through a full range of motion. The internal dumbbell lateral raise that follows shifts the load onto the front and medial delts through a controlled arc. The 30X0 tempo on the raise means three seconds down.  Control the lowering rather than dropping the arms. Push close to failure on each set.
"}]
